packageRules.description: Prisma 8 is adopted only after GA, in a separate iteration (CLAUDE.md section 6.4).
The @nestjs/* packages declare peer ranges on each other and update in one PR.
typescript-eslint 8 declares the peer range typescript <6.1.0; TypeScript 7 waits for typescript-eslint and @nestjs/cli (docs/ROADMAP.md section 10).
A PostgreSQL 18+ image keeps data in /var/lib/postgresql/<major>/docker, so a new major starts an empty cluster in the same volume; a major upgrade needs a manual data migration.
